environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection layer. The Flask app is served via gunicorn with 4 workers, accessed directly after TLS termination at the ELB. Instance role has no special permissions. The application is the sole occupant of the instance.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener on 443 forwarding to instance:8080
config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, no NAT gateway needed
